description:
List your integrations

Returns the account's connected integrations, newest first, as a bare JSON array with no paging. Stored configuration is deliberately left out of the list view: read a single integration to see which of its fields are set. A reseller key may pass `userId` to list one of its own customers' integrations instead; asking for a user who is not a customer of that reseller is refused with 403. On a key that is not a reseller key, `userId` is accepted but has no effect and the caller's own integrations are returned.

userId.description: Reseller keys only: list the integrations of this customer instead of your own. The user must be one of your customers, otherwise the request is refused with 403. Ignored on non-reseller keys.
